# NeuralRecruit

> NeuralRecruit is a source-available web application for explainable resume intelligence and job-matching decision support in technical hiring. It organizes evidence for mandatory human review and does not make hiring decisions.

## Key pages

- [NeuralRecruit showcase](https://neuralrecruit.vercel.app/): Product overview, resume-review workflow, job-matching workflow, safeguards, supported IT roles, architecture, and frequently asked questions.
- [About NeuralRecruit](https://neuralrecruit.vercel.app/about): Project purpose, implementation summary, responsible-use principles, source code, and feedback path.
- [Product features](https://neuralrecruit.vercel.app/features): Four focused workflows, inspectable report output, supported IT scope, and operational boundaries.
- [Methodology](https://neuralrecruit.vercel.app/methodology): Document extraction, IT terminology normalization, retrieval signals, experience handling, score interpretation, and limitations.
- [Responsible-use safeguards](https://neuralrecruit.vercel.app/safeguards): Human oversight, fairness boundaries, upload controls, retention minimization, and organizational responsibilities.
- [Public showcase privacy](https://neuralrecruit.vercel.app/privacy): Browser and backend processing, temporary-file cleanup, disabled history persistence, hosting boundaries, and safer demonstration practices.
- [Source code](https://github.com/kottusaikumar/AI-Resume-Screening-System): Complete React, TypeScript, FastAPI, and deterministic NLP implementation.
- [Sitemap](https://neuralrecruit.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable pages.

## Product capabilities

- Resume-only review for ATS readability, structure, skills, experience evidence, and suitable IT role families.
- Resume-to-job-description comparison using transparent lexical, semantic, skill, positional, experience, and quality signals.
- Candidate ranking against one shared job description.
- Role comparison for one resume.
- CSV and PDF evidence exports.

## Responsible-use constraints

- Results are advisory evidence signals, not hiring decisions.
- Human review is required before employment decisions.
- Candidate documents are processed temporarily in the public showcase.
- No paid or external LLM inference API is required.
